capabilities: Translate a selection or a whole note with an OpenAI-compatible LLM
Review and edit the translation in a side panel before inserting it
Preserve YAML front-matter when translating a full note
Switch the active API provider with a command
Edit the system prompt with a {{targetLanguage}} placeholder
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian Community Plugin directory, so manual installation is required. Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true); mobile untested. API keys are stored unencrypted in data.json inside the plugin folder. Requires Obsidian ≥ 1.13.0.
intentEvidence: TranslateNote is a fork of LLM Translate by 陈与小金
motivation: The author forked LLM Translate because it was Chinese-only (interface, errors, default prompt), putting a good translator out of reach for anyone who does not read Chinese.
problem: Other translation plugins overwrite the note with the result, leaving no way to check the translation against the source or recover if it is wrong.

relations.evidence: TranslateNote is a fork of LLM Translate by 陈与小金
which is itself derived from obsidian-llm-shortcut by chernodub

requires.name: API key from at least one provider (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Z.AI, OpenRouter or custom)
Ollama (for local models via a custom endpoint)

summary: LLM translation plugin that sends a selection or whole note to an OpenAI-compatible provider and shows the result in a side panel for review before inserting.
